title: 第25章 轩然大波第26章 安稳发展
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
李北玄对他点了点头，四大家族的强者全都被他灭杀了，而且族中大小事务都有自己这个儿子打理，他也放心。
他自己只要为李家保驾护航便可以了。
于是，李北玄一个闪身便消失在了李家众人面前。
李家众人见到自家老祖离开，连忙回过神来，朝着李北玄离去的方向躬身行礼！
“恭送老祖！”
“恭送老祖！”
……
特别是李青山，他第一次直观感受到老祖的强大，眼神之中露出炽热的神色。
老祖竟是紫府境界的超级强者啊！
“紫府境界，竟然是这般风采！”他眼中闪过一抹坚定。
要以老祖为目标，未来也要感受一番紫府境界的风采！
见到李家众人已经逐渐从激动的情绪中平复下来。
李天行深吸一口气，然后将目光投向了聚集在一起的族人，他的声音如同洪钟一般，在这片空间里回荡着：“诸位，你们老祖刚刚说的话，可都听清楚了！”
他目光威严扫视四周，带着一股锐气！
紧接着，李天行再次高声喊道：“今日之后，北源河畔将再无四大家族！”
他的话语如同惊雷一般，在李家族人之中炸响，引起了一阵骚动。
然而，李天行并没有给族人太多反应的时间，他紧接着吼道：“族人们，随我杀向四家，斩草除根！”
他声音气势如虹，激励着每一个李家族人的斗志。
下方的一众李家族人在这一刻也都被李天行的气势所感染，他们纷纷振臂高呼：“杀！”“杀！”“杀！”……
这一声声怒吼，汇聚成了一股强大的声浪，在岔水河前激荡开来，使得这一刻的气势达到了顶点。

因为这对于李家众人来说，这是一个前所未有的时刻！
有种做梦的感觉一样！
在这之前，他们李家还只是偏于一隅，但随着自家老祖大发神威之后。
北源河畔便属于他们李家的了！
接着，李天行大手一挥，带着李家众人朝着离他们李家最近的周家而去。
……
“胜利了！我们李～李家胜了！”
伴随着这声高呼，一名满脸喜色的普通族人如疾风般狂奔进李家族地。
他的声音在空气中回荡，他要将这一喜讯传递给每一个族人。
李家族地中的人们被这突如其来的呼喊声吸引，纷纷停下手中的事情，迎上前去。
他们的脸上都写满了焦虑和担忧，因为家族正在与四大家族进行一场生死大战，而他们这些普通族人却无法直接参与战斗，只能在族中默默祈祷。
“结果怎么样了？”众人急切地问道。
那名激动的族人稍稍平复了一下呼吸，然后用颤抖的声音说道：“胜了！我们李家战胜了四大家族……”
那个激动得气喘吁吁的族人一口气将刚才岔水河岸发生的事情说了出来。
“老祖还说，北源河畔以后再无四大家族……”
李家众人听着那人讲述，一个个激动得难以置信！
有人倒吸一口凉气！
“吸……”
“这是真的吗？”
他们不敢相信这竟然是真的！

若是北源河畔再无四大家族，那岂不是说，他们李家要一统北源河畔了吗？
如果是真得话，他们李家要崛起了啊！
……
content_en:
Li Bei
He only needs to protect the Li family.
As a result, Li Beixuan disappeared in front of everyone in the Li family.
When everyone in the Li family saw their ancestor leaving, they quickly came to their senses and bowed in the direction where Li Beixuan left!
"Farewell to my ancestor!"
"Farewell to my ancestor!"
…
Especially Li Qingshan, for the first time he intuitively felt the power of his ancestor, with a fiery look in his eyes.
The ancestor is actually a super strong man in the Zifu realm!
"The Zifu realm is so graceful!" A flash of determination flashed in his eyes.
We must aim at the ancestors and experience the elegance of the Zifu realm in the future!
Seeing that everyone in the Li family has gradually calmed down from their excitement.
Li Tianxing took a deep breath, and then turned his gaze to the gathered tribesmen. His voice was like a loud bell, echoing in the space: "Everyone, you heard clearly what your ancestor just said!"
He glanced around with majestic eyes, filled with vigor!
Immediately afterwards, Li Tianxing shouted again: "After today, there will be no more four major families on the Beiyuan River!"
His words were like thunder, exploding among the Li family members, causing a commotion.
However, Li Tianxing did not give the tribesmen much time to react. He immediately shouted: "Tribesmen, follow me to kill the four families and eradicate them!"
His voice was as powerful as a rainbow, inspiring the fighting spirit of every member of the Li family.
The Li family members below were also infected by Li Tianxing's aura at this moment. They all raised their arms and shouted: "Kill!" "Kill!" "Kill!"...
These roars gathered into a powerful sound wave, which surged in front of the Chashui River, making the momentum at this moment reach its peak.
Because this is an unprecedented moment for everyone in the Li family!
It feels like a dream!
Before this, their Li family was just in a corner, but after their ancestor showed great power.
The Beiyuan River belongs to their Li family!
Then, Li Tianxing waved his hand and led everyone in the Li family towards the Zhou family, which was closest to their Li family.
…
"Victory! Our Li~Li family has won!"
Following this shout, an ordinary tribesman with a happy face rushed into the Li family land like a gust of wind.
His voice echoed in the air, and he wanted to convey this good news to every clan member.
The people in the Li family's land were attracted by the sudden shouts. They stopped what they were doing and stepped forward to greet him.
Their faces were full of anxiety and worry, because their family was engaged in a life-and-death battle with the four major families, but ordinary tribesmen like them could not directly participate in the battle and could only pray silently in the tribe.
"What happened?" Everyone asked eagerly.
The excited tribesman calmed down his breathing for a moment, and then said in a trembling voice: "Victory! Our Li family defeated the four major families..."
The tribesman, who was breathless with excitement, told in one breath what had just happened on the bank of the Chashui River.
"The ancestor also said that there will no longer be four major families on the Beiyuan River..."
Everyone in the Li family was incredibly excited as they listened to the man's story!
Someone gasped!
"Suck..."
"Is this true?"
They couldn't believe this was true!
If there are no longer four major families on the Beiyuan River, doesn't it mean that the Li family will dominate the Beiyuan River?
If this is true, their Li family will rise!
…
